statements.text: I want to be clear. This administration will block such efforts, full stop. We will safeguard American AI and chip technologies from theft and misuse, work with our allies and partners to strengthen and extend these protections,
statements.context: Vice President’s Paris AI Action Summit speech, immediately after describing foreign adversaries’ military and surveillance use of stolen AI.

attribution.speaker: JD Vance
